expected.rationale: The claim was submitted 125 days after the service, past the 90 days in QUIL-TF-1.1. QUIL-TF-2.1(a) extends the limit when coverage was added retroactively, allowing 90 days from the date the provider was notified. The plan's notice is dated 2026-05-02 and the claim was submitted on 2026-05-20, 18 days later.
